title: JASPIC: iPhone email-login preview only (Gmail OAuth disabled)
purpose: 通知・メール配信とその運用に関する変更／認証・アクセス制御に関する変更／画面表示や操作に関する変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
## Scope
Standalone reviewable PR based on main, separated from Draft PR #155. Adds a Safari-compatible Supabase email login preview at `/jaspic/oauth`, with Google consent button disabled, and an OAuth start endpoint that always returns HTTP 503. Uses the existing EmergencyAlert public Supabase configuration and prevents email OTP from creating new accounts (`shouldCreateUser:false`).

## Must remain disabled
- No Google OAuth code exchange / token retrieval / Gmail sending.
- No service-role key, migration, database changes, cron, Supabase secrets, or old Windows changes.
- No merge or deploy without separate user approval.

## Acceptance
CI/preview pass, email OTP login link is manually tested on iPhone after separately approved deployment, and no unrelated changes are present.
